text: Started shared conformance admission layer. Added typed SurfacePlanRevision/SurfaceBackendId, stable feature reports with explicit caveats, resource-event and phase-timing ADTs, admission paths, a 14-case semantic matrix spanning orientation/geometry/layers/thresholds/composition/lighting/layout/picking/lifecycle, and exact validation that camera/style/data/timepoint paths cannot silently rebuild geometry. Raster, JavaFX, and Three.js now publish explicit capabilities; all declare world clipping unsupported rather than silently ignoring it. Focused verification: surfaceView JVM 14/14 and JS 14/14; raster JVM 8/8 and JS 8/8; JavaFX 10/10; Three.js 6/6. Remaining in this child: adapters that emit unified observations, pinned 32k/164k x 1/4/8 benchmark matrix with JSON/hardware metadata, and one-command/live receipt wiring.
